title: •Obsidian 10
caption: •Obsidian 10 (V)
game_text: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. OS-72-10 deploys -2 aboard. When lost from Endor, a mobile system, or a sector, may place this starship (and cards aboard it) in owner’s Used Pile.
lore: Recalled to defend second Death Star during construction. Stationed aboard _Thunderflare_.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner 'STARFIGHTER: TIE/ln' in mixed case as the slip prints it (another card in this project has TIE/LN in caps; the 'l' vs 'I' is indistinguishable in the face, TIE/ln is the class name). Third stat box NO HYPERDRIVE (label only, new label — not NO HYPERSPEED). Deploy 1 / forfeit 3 — the stub's 'deploy=3' is the forfeit (stub error). No scomp ring, no column icons (only the set sphere). Curly apostrophe in owner’s. Lore corrected from scan: _Thunderflare_ is italic on the printed card (wiki plain). Base scan only 350 px; DS2 copyright by set convention. Modern: VB2 only (-pre, 350 px).
